query:
The Oyelaran family operates with an expectation that everyone brings a food dish to gatherings. Based on the conversations, does this expectation seem to hold equally for all family members — or does someone appear to have a different relationship to it, and how would you know?

Options:
A. Tolu
B. Nkem
C. Kayode
D. Seun
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Insists everyone brings a dish; drinks not enough.
[2] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Final confirmation: gathering on January 25th at Tolu and Funke's, 3pm, with assigned dishes.
[3] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[4] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[5] (about=Kayode, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:44:00) Can do drinks? Easier for me to sort drinks than food?
[6] (about=Nkem, core, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem would like to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkem, group-interaction, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem asks to learn a dish from Adaeze; Adaeze agrees to teach on Sundays.
[8] (about=Seun, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:39:00) 3pm works honestly, I will bring a vegan jollof so no one feels obligated to accommodate me I mean I will do a big pot
[9] (about=Tolu, core, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Tolu notes Adaeze's recipe adaptation is a significant data point for family dinner planning.
[10] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Will bring ofe akwu as last time; states puff puff is not a dish.
agent_answer:
C. Kayode

Kayode appears to have a different relationship to the dish expectation. While others volunteer food dishes — Auntie Grace brings moin moin, Seun brings vegan jollof, Uncle Dele brings ofe akwu — Kayode asks: *“Can do drinks? Easier for me to sort drinks than food?”* This shows he would prefer to bring drinks instead of a food dish. Adaeze’s stance is that “drinks not enough” and everyone should bring a dish, and Funke even suggests Kayode could bring drinks *and* puff puff to be covered. So the expectation does not rest equally on Kayode — he is the one who tries to swap a food dish for drinks.

query:
The family treats the Sunday video call as a shared routine that everyone participates in. Based on what the conversations show, does this hold equally for all members — or does someone seem to relate to it differently, and what tells you that?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Kayode
C. Tolu
D. Bisi
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Confirms Sunday call happened; Emeka was on briefly and said he needed to rest.
[2] (about=Nkem, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Thinks missing church is natural after a full day; asks if Sunday call happened.
[3] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
agent_answer:
A. Emeka

Adaeze’s note shows the Sunday call happened, but **Emeka only came on briefly and said he needed to rest** — so he didn’t take part in the full routine the way the others seem to.  
For **Kayode, Tolu, and Bisi**, there is no record in the material showing a different relationship to the call.
